name: Stack Overflow
description: Enables AI tools and agents to access trusted developer knowledge from Stack Overflow.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Stack Overflow to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Stack Overflow to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.stackoverflow.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Stack Overflow MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stack Overflow provides these MCP tools: so_search, get_content, and answers.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Stack Overflow?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Stack Overflow in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Stack Overflow MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stack Overflow requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Stack Overflow is developed by Stack Overflow. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
